name: n8n-interaction-gateway
description: Generic signed-webhook interaction gateway for the n8n Workflow-as-Code portfolio: one authenticated POST edge that HMAC-verifies, size-limits, secret-strips, and routes a request by allowlisted intent to sibling workflow(s), with trace propagation. v0.1.0 ships the SDK workflow + pure security core, with the security controls + routing DECISION proven OFFLINE (verify:gateway 17/17 + verify:workflow 9 scenarios incl. a differential vs the core). Live Execute-Workflow sibling execution is opt-in (requires each target to expose an executeWorkflowTrigger).
